b2-nicaragua-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Why an Eight?
b2-nicaragua-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are planning a trip to Nicaragua, and he asks you why the island of Ometepe looks so strange on the map.
b2-nicaragua-01.prompt: Tell Carlos why Ometepe is shaped like an eight.
cues: Say what shape the island has
b2-nicaragua-01.target: Ometepe tiene forma de ocho porque la forman dos volcanes.
b2-nicaragua-01.english: Ometepe is shaped like an eight because two volcanoes form it.
b2-nicaragua-01.canDo: I can give a reason with *porque* and a result with *por eso*.

b2-nicaragua-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Darío Died
b2-nicaragua-02.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are listening to a talk about Rubén Darío, and she asks you where and when he died.
b2-nicaragua-02.prompt: Tell Meg where and when Darío died, putting the place first.
b2-nicaragua-02.target: En León murió Rubén Darío, en febrero de 1916.
b2-nicaragua-02.english: In León Rubén Darío died, in February 1916.
b2-nicaragua-02.canDo: I can put an adjective, a place or a time first to stress it, as in *Decisiva fue…*.

b2-nicaragua-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What If?
b2-nicaragua-03.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are watching a documentary about Sandino, and he asks you what you think about the pact of Tipitapa.
b2-nicaragua-03.prompt: Tell Carlos what would have happened if Sandino had accepted the pact.
cues: Say what he would not have done
b2-nicaragua-03.target: Si Sandino hubiera aceptado el pacto, no habría luchado en las montañas.
b2-nicaragua-03.english: If Sandino had accepted the pact, he would not have fought in the mountains.
b2-nicaragua-03.canDo: I can say what would have happened if something had been different, with *si hubiera… habría…*.

b2-nicaragua-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Painters in Spite of Everything
b2-nicaragua-04.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are reading an article about Solentiname, and she asks you why the paintings are special.
b2-nicaragua-04.prompt: Tell Meg what the peasants of Solentiname did in spite of their situation.
cues: Say what they began to do
b2-nicaragua-04.target: A pesar de no tener estudios de arte, los campesinos de Solentiname empezaron a pintar.
b2-nicaragua-04.english: Although they had no art training, the peasants of Solentiname began to paint.
b2-nicaragua-04.canDo: I can say that something continued in spite of a difficulty, with *a pesar de* and *pese a*.

b2-nicaragua-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Says What
b2-nicaragua-05.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are reading the news about Nicaragua, and he asks you what is known about the 2018 protests.
b2-nicaragua-05.prompt: Tell Carlos what the UN said and what the government said, naming each source.
cues: Give the UN source and a number
b2-nicaragua-05.target: Según la CIDH, murieron más de trescientas personas. El gobierno dijo que las protestas eran un intento de golpe de Estado.
b2-nicaragua-05.english: According to the IACHR, more than three hundred people died. The government said the protests were a coup attempt.
b2-nicaragua-05.canDo: I can say who said what, with *según* and *dijo que*.

b2-nicaragua-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Review: Nicaragua
b2-nicaragua-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are planning a trip to Nicaragua, and she asks what you remember about the lake and about Darío.
b2-nicaragua-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg one fact about each.
cues: Say why the lake has waves
Say where Darío died, putting the place first
b2-nicaragua-consolidation.target: El lago es muy grande; por eso a veces tiene olas. En León murió Rubén Darío.
b2-nicaragua-consolidation.english: The lake is very big; that is why it sometimes has waves. In León Rubén Darío died.
b2-nicaragua-consolidation.canDo: I can give a reason with *porque* and a result with *por eso*.
